title: Enterprise contract decision fabric and sales self-service guardrails
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Build a decision fabric that lets sales safely self-serve on common MSA/DPA concessions while automatically scoring risk and surfacing pricing adjustments. This ticket scopes the product surface, heuristics for auto-approve vs. legal review, telemetry required for pricing experiments, and the UX guardrails to keep indemnity/liability changes within approved bands.
background: Currently sales files ad-hoc redlines and legal is a bottleneck for mid-market deals under $100k ARR. We ran a pilot in Q4 that allowed two concession types to be auto-approved with manual verification; that pilot reduced turnaround time by 40% but surfaced edge cases around chained concession interactions and pricing leakage. This work combines contract automation with pricing experiment wiring so we can measure revenue uplift and risk exposure together.
goals: Enable safe self-serve for 6 common concession templates (e.g., limited indemnity language, SLA cap adjustments, data processing clause variations)
Provide a deterministic risk score and recommended pricing uplift per concession
Ensure all automated approvals produce a complete audit trail and optional legal-snoop alerts for anomalous patterns
Instrument for A/B pricing experiments to measure revenue/cycle time impact
success_metrics: Median contract turnaround time for qualifying deals reduced from 6 days to <48 hours
% of qualifying redlines auto-approved >= 60% in first 3 months
No >1% of auto-approved deals produce post-signature security incidents tied to concession types
Measured delta in average deal price for auto-approved vs. manual flows (tracked in pricing experiment dashboard)
acceptance_criteria: Decision fabric UI in Sales Console that lists allowed concessions and shows computed risk score
Backend rule engine that evaluates a concession set and returns: auto-approve / require-legal / escalate-to-SR
Pricing adjustment suggestion persisted to quote line items and surfaced to Sales before signature
Audit log with immutable record (who, what, when, linked PR/contract) stored for 7 years and exportable
End-to-end telemetry (turnaround_time, approval_path, pricing_delta, post_sign_security_flag) flowing to the enterprise telemetry dashboard
tasks: PM: finalize concession taxonomy and risk-weight mapping
Design: mock Sales Console flow and guardrail microcopy
Eng: implement rule-evaluation microservice and stable API
Eng: integrate pricing experiment hooks (feature flags + logging to experiments store)
Legal: sign off on initial auto-approve templates and fallback copy
Security/Compliance: review audit export format and retention plan
GTM: prepare enablement doc for AE cohort and pilot criteria
design_notes: Design opts for an inline, non-modal flow: when AE selects concession template, a right-rail panel shows the risk score, suggested price uplift, and an inline checkbox 'Apply safeguards and proceed'. Microcopy emphasizes 'auto-approved under current policy, subject to audit.' We avoid complex multi-step wizards for the pilot to reduce cognitive load.
engineering_notes: We will build a stateless decision microservice (Go) that evaluates an ordered list of concession tokens against a rule graph stored in the config service. Initial rule graph is simple boolean thresholds + additive risk weights. Must emit detailed decision_reason and decision_hash for audit. Integrate with experiments service via event bridge and add feature flag gate for pilot cohort. Data retention policy: audit events to blobstore and indexed pointers in Redshift for queries.
rollout_plan: Phase 1 (pilot, 2 weeks): enable for AE cohort in US-North region, limited to deals < $100k. Phase 2 (beta, 6 weeks): expand templates to 6 concession types and enable for mid-market segment. Phase 3 (GA): lift region limits after security & legal signoff, tie into billing for pricing adjustments. Each phase gated on safety metrics and legal review.
qa_plan: QA matrix includes unit tests for rule combinations, fuzz tests for concession chains, end-to-end flows using sandbox contracts, and manual checks of audit exports. Create test harness that replays 500 historic redlines against the new rule engine and compares outcomes to manual adjudications.
risks_mitigations: Risk: Chained concessions produce higher risk than sum of parts — Mitigation: conservative default to require legal when multiple high-risk tokens appear
Risk: Pricing leakage (discounting too deep) — Mitigation: enforce hard limits on suggested uplift and tie to sales quota approvals
Risk: Audit/retention non-compliance across regions — Mitigation: consult Compliance early and feature-flag region-specific retention settings
Risk: AE confusion about when legal still required — Mitigation: clear inline microcopy and required training for pilot cohort
